patch_description: The current rule keeps the initial width of 0.5 fixed and ignores feedback. This proposal uses 0.15-rate fitness smoothing, an adaptive width target, and archive-relative success feedback centered at 0.25. Higher fitness narrows mutations; stalled progress and drops in archive fitness increase exploration. Persistent memory detects changes without a task identifier or switch schedule. These choices aim to improve acquisition while limiting disruptive mutations; performance requires evaluation.
